note: What a server sends to change the state of an inhibitor, and say how long the new state lasts. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: state
fields.note: What state the inhibitor takes. Any other value becomes the inhibitor's state and changes nothing shown, and a 0 less than 1.2 seconds before it then never shows; a later 0 or 1 still applies.

0.name: down
0.note: The inhibitor goes down 1.2 seconds after the message, whatever duration says.

fields.name: duration
fields.note: How long the state lasts, in whole seconds. A client stores it whatever state the message holds and counts it down; its end changes nothing shown, and only a 1 brings the inhibitor back.
